content:
sam_support: Heads up team — customer NeoMetrics reports two invoices for the same subscription period after a failed card + PO flow. INV-2026-0087 and INV-2026-0088. They want one reversed and a clear audit for revenue. cc @jordan_finance @alex_w

alex_w: Can you paste payment traces and webhook events? Need to confirm order of events and which invoice was created by PO vs by card charge. :eyes:

sam_support: Quick dump below (sanitized):
```
-- webhooks --
POST /v1/invoices  payload: {"order_id":"OM-332","po_number":"PO-7789","tax_exempt":false} -> 202 created -> invoice INV-2026-0087
payment_attempt: none
-- later --
Payment provider callback charge.succeeded provider_tx:ch_1JX...  amount 9990 -> triggered invoice generation -> INV-2026-0088
```

maria_ops: Ah — looks like our PO webhook creates an invoice immediately when PO arrives. If card retry comes in later (and idempotency not used), the system creates a second invoice. We saw this pattern with a different customer once.

billing-bot: charge.failed ch_1JY... reason: "card_declined" at 2026-06-12T14:02:11Z

sam_support: Timeline we have: card tried -> failed -> customer submitted PO -> PO webhook created INV-2026-0087 -> card retried and succeeded -> system created INV-2026-0088. Both invoices show the same period and items.

jordan_finance: Are VAT lines different? That affects how we reverse and credit. If one invoice is tax-exempt (PO) and the card one has VAT charged, we need to issue credit note accordingly so tax reporting stays clean.

sam_support: Good catch — INV-2026-0087 (PO) shows tax_exempt: true on the webhook record. INV-2026-0088 (card) has VAT 20% applied. So they're inconsistent.

alex_w: Action plan: 1) Hold payment capture for any further retries for this order id (done?) 2) Refund the card charge for INV-2026-0088 and create credit note for reconciliation 3) Mark INV-2026-0088 as reversed and link to PO so accounting sees single invoice. I can run the refund if payments team approves.

maria_ops: For prevention: we need to de-dupe invoice creation by checking order_id + po_number + invoice_period and honor idempotency keys on the PO webhook. I'll file a small ops ticket to change behavior.

jordan_finance: Please route refund through refunded_txn REF-98765 and create a credit_note CN-2026-045. I need the journal entries to match: reverse revenue on INV-2026-0088 and keep INV-2026-0087 as the canonical invoice tied to PO.

sam_support: Processing now — initiated refund to card: REF-98765 (stripe ch_1JX... refunded). Marking INV-2026-0088 status "refunded" and adding note: "Accidental duplicate invoice due to PO+card retry. See CN-2026-045."

billing-bot: refund.succeeded REF-98765 amount 9990 at 2026-06-12T14:28:09Z

alex_w: Done on system side: INV-2026-0088 -> reversed, refund txn REF-98765 linked. Created credit note CN-2026-045 and attached to INV-2026-0087 for audit. Added internal tag `duplicate-invoice-auto-reverse`. :white_check_mark:

jordan_finance: Thanks — can you add the tax breakdown to CN-2026-045 showing VAT reclaimed for the reversed invoice? Also attach payment provider proof (refund id). I'll prepare accounting entries once that's attached.

sam_support: Attached refund proof and updated credit note with VAT reclaim line. Also added customer-facing message: "We issued a refund for the duplicate charge and consolidated your billing to the PO invoice. Sorry for the confusion." Sent to billing contact at NeoMetrics.

maria_ops: Filed ops ticket OPS-2492 to add idempotency and pre-check for existing invoice by (order_id, period, po_number). Owner: @alex_w. ETA EOW for hotfix, longer-term review next sprint.

alex_w: I'll own OPS-2492. Quick hotfix: check for existing invoice with same order_id and item hash before creating new one. If found, skip creation and emit warning. I'll also add logging to surface conflicting tax flags so we can avoid silent VAT mismatches.

sam_support: Customer confirmed refund hit their card and is happy with the consolidation. Closing thread after ops ticket created. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

jordan_finance: Please keep me posted if OPS-2492 uncovers other edge cases. Closing on my side once CN posted to ledger.

maria_ops: Noted. I'll follow up on OPS-2492 progress and ensure a post-mortem entry in billing docs.
